% ============================================================
% COVER LETTER PREAMBLE (design only). Matches the CV preamble.
% Assemble: cat preamble-cl.tex payload/header-cl.tex content.tex > CL.tex && tectonic CL.tex
% header-cl.tex (generated by /payload-setup) carries the footer, \begin{document} + name block.
% ============================================================
\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}

\usepackage[margin=2.1cm,top=1.4cm,bottom=1.8cm]{geometry}
\usepackage{charter}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{parskip}

\definecolor{rulegray}{gray}{0.55}
\definecolor{headblue}{RGB}{20,45,90}

\setlength{\parskip}{9pt}
\linespread{1.05}
% Re: line — bold, brand colour, sits above the salutation
\newcommand{\subjectline}[1]{%
  \par\vspace{4pt}\noindent\textbf{\color{headblue}#1}\par\vspace{-2pt}}

% Recipient block — tight leading, no paragraph spacing between lines
\newcommand{\recipient}[3]{%
  \par\noindent\begingroup\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}%
  #1\\#2\\#3\par\endgroup}

\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}
\setlength{\footskip}{34pt}
\frenchspacing
